text:
Maria: Heads up — planning to enable a low-precision int4 profile behind a feature flag (ff_low_prec_v2). Need canary audience sizing + guardrails. Goal: ~40% token cost reduction while keeping quality within our eval thresholds.

Dan: Which model(s) and routes are we touching? Prod or staging first?

Maria: Prod, but single-model limited canary to start. Routes: /generate (global) and /chat (us-west). Model: rwd-7b-compat-v3 quantized-int4.

Priya: Suggest start at 0.25% global traffic for 24h. Monitor perplexity + rollout eval set (QA prompts) and user-facing error rates. Fallback to fp16 if quality regression >1.5% on evals.

Alex: Add latency SLO checks too: p95 increase < 15ms and p99 < 40ms. If exceeded, automatic gate should flip the flag off.

Maria: Can someone add a Gatekeeper rule in the rollout config? Example config snippet:
```yaml
flag: ff_low_prec_v2
model: rwd-7b-compat-v3-int4
initial_traffic: 0.25%
canary_window: 24h
rollback_conditions:
  - eval_quality_delta: >1.5%
  - p95_latency_delta_ms: >15
  - p99_latency_ms: >40
fallback: fp16
```

Dan: I'll open infra PR to wire the gate into the rollout orchestration and add the global p99 check. Will also add an auto-rollback action. Ping me when ready.

Priya: Important: ensure KV cache warmup for the canary cohort or first requests will suffer high latency and token counts. Also route the canary to a dedicated pool in us-west so we can isolate traffic.

Maria: Good call. We'll set canary pool: us-west-dedicated and warm the cache with synthetic prompts. Who's on-call for the window?

Alex: I'll monitor during the first 24h. Please set alerts: error-rate >0.5%, eval_quality_delta >1%, and abrupt p99 spikes. Also whitelist internal QA accounts so we can hit it harder.

deploy-bot: cf-rollout/1795004321 started canary at 0.25% for rwd-7b-compat-v3-int4 -> us-west-dedicated

Dan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3245 - added gate + rollback rule + warmup job. Reviewers: @Maria @Alex @Priya

Maria: LGTM, left a small comment on the warmup sequence.

Priya: Early metrics at +6h: eval quality delta +0.9% (within threshold), latency p95 +8ms, token cost reduced by 42%. Recommend bump to 1% after 6 more hours if stable.

Alex: Noted a p99 spike at 17:12 UTC — looks like a worker OOM on a single host. I drained that host and scaled additional workers. Gate did not fire because p99 check was per-cluster; updating rule to global p99 now.

Dan: Ack — updated the orchestration rule to aggregate p99 globally and added host-level OOM alerts. Pushed patch in infra PR.

Maria: Updated rollout config to include the global p99 guard. New PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3250. Keeping canary active while we observe for another 12h.

deploy-bot: rollout update: increased to 1% at 1795007921

Alex: Please keep the QA whitelist and alerts enabled. If anything unusual, flip the rollback.

Maria: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a short postmortem if any regressions show up.
